_note: The README screen at the far end of the range (ours). The backstop's front face is z = -106.75 and the wall is 9 m tall (range.ts): the screen sits 5 cm proud of it and the arrow plates 13 cm, so a round reaches them before the wall stops it. It is 16 m wide so the text reads from the 100 m mark with an optic, and from anywhere near it without one. Canvas pixels per metre, then the screen's own layout in those pixels.

Every canvas keeps its pixel size (px rises as the width falls), so the pages lay out the same.
